_comment: Single source of truth for the models this worker needs.
'bake: true'  -> downloaded at image build time (small, never changes).
'bake: false' -> downloaded on the worker's first start (big; see README 'Model storage').
'dest' is relative to the ComfyUI models root (models/<dest>/<file>).
'size' is the upstream byte size, used as a sanity check only; the real expected
size is read from Hugging Face at download time, so a stale entry warns instead of failing.
